Class GameInputHandler

java.lang.Object
com.tetris.ui.GameInputHandler
public class GameInputHandler extends Object
Manages user keyboard input and maps keystrokes to game actions.

This class abstracts the JavaFX KeyEvent logic away from the main View. It supports dual control schemes (Arrow Keys and WASD) and handles:

  • Movement (Left, Right, Soft Drop).
  • Actions (Rotate, Hard Drop).
  • Game State Controls (Pause, New Game, Mute, Power-ups).

  • Constructor Details

    • GameInputHandler

      public GameInputHandler(InputEventListener eventListener, Consumer<ViewData> onViewUpdate, Consumer<DownData> onDownUpdate, Runnable onPauseToggle, Runnable onNewGame, Runnable onMusicToggle)
      Constructs a new Input Handler with the necessary callbacks.
      Parameters:
      eventListener - The controller interface to notify when logic events occur (e.g., "Move Left requested").
      onViewUpdate - Callback to refresh the view after lateral movement or rotation.
      onDownUpdate - Callback to refresh the view after a drop action (which might clear lines).
      onPauseToggle - Callback to pause/unpause the game loop.
      onNewGame - Callback to restart the game.
      onMusicToggle - Callback to mute/unmute audio.

  • Method Details

    • initKeyActions

      private void initKeyActions()
      Initializes the key mappings.

      Mappings:

      • Left/A: Move Left
      • Right/D: Move Right
      • Up/W: Rotate
      • Down/S: Soft Drop
      • Space: Hard Drop

    • handleKeyPress

      public void handleKeyPress(javafx.scene.input.KeyEvent event)
      Processes a raw key press event from JavaFX.

      It first checks for global game state keys (P, N, M, F). If the key is not a global control, it looks up the key in the keyActions map to trigger gameplay movements.

      Parameters:
      event - The JavaFX KeyEvent to process.
